title: Geometric invertibility of canonical ring scalar maps and their exceptional mates
statement:
Fix a prime $l$, an algebraic closure $\Omega$ of $\mathbf Q_l$, a finite-field datum $D$ with $l\ne D.p$, finite-type $D.k$-schemes $X,Y$, a separated finite-type $D.k$-morphism $f:X\to Y$, a compactification $c$, ring stages $s,t$, and an Allowed actual coefficient map $a:s\to t$ [def-sf-ring-stage-assembly-data, def-sf-constructible-exceptional-assembly-data]. Let $A,B$ be supplied exact adjunction operations at $s,t$ with ambient compact-support left realizations $r_A,r_B$, and $S_X,S_Y$ endpoint scalar functors with their ambient realizations $\rho_X,\rho_Y$. Write $I_{W,r}$ for the full inclusion at stage $r$, $P_r$ for the actual ambient compact-support functor at stage $r$, $T_W$ for ambient derived scalar extension along $a$ at $W$, and $\gamma:P_sT_Y\to T_XP_t$ for the canonical proper/open coefficient comparison. Then (1) $I_{X,s}\gamma$ is invertible; and (2) for every natural isomorphism $q:A.F S_Y\simeq S_X B.F$ satisfying, for all $K$ in the source finite-Tor category, the equation
$$ I_{Y,t}(q_K)\,;\,(r_B)_{S_XK}\,;\,P_t((\rho_X)_K)=(\rho_Y)_{A.FK}\,;\,T_Y((r_A)_K)\,;\,\gamma_{I_{X,s}K}, $$
the right counit mate $\operatorname{mateEquiv}(A.\mathrm{adjunction},B.\mathrm{adjunction})(q^{-1})$ is invertible. Semicolons denote composition in the written order. This asserts only the two invertibility tests; no scalar functor, shift structure or comparison datum is constructed.

proof.text: Construct a coherent finite/integral family with its normalized system reconstruction, before scalar comparisons. Lift the given algebraic closure to the scheme universe; the finite and integral stage categories do not depend on that closure.

Apply exceptionalIntegralScalarMates_core to this family. Its Comparison supplies invertible q and b and QNormalized. The counit formula and injectivity of the target adjunction Hom bijection identify b with mateEquiv of inverse q. QNormalized also writes the ambient scalar comparison as a composite of isomorphisms.

Full faithfulness lifts the two left realizations and the two scalar realizations to natural isomorphisms. Compose them with the constructed q. Naturality of the four realizations and the original QNormalized equation prove normalization for this transferred q. Faithfulness of the target inclusion and cancellation of the realization isomorphisms identify every supplied normalized q with it. The conjugateEquiv/mateEquiv composition identities transfer the invertible mate through the four isomorphisms.

theorem ring_canonical_scalar_invertibility
    (D : FiniteFieldDatum.{max u v}) (_hl : l ≠ D.p)
    {X Y : Scheme.{max u v}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    [X.Over (Spec (.of D.k))] [Y.Over (Spec (.of D.k))]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spec (.of D.k))] [QuasiCompact (X ↘ Spec (.of D.k))]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (Y ↘ Spec (.of D.k))] [QuasiCompact (Y ↘ Spec (.of D.k))]
    [f.IsOver (Spec (.of D.k))] [IsSeparated f] [LocallyOfFiniteType f] [QuasiCompact f]
    (c : Compactification f) {s t : RingStage.{max u v} l}
    (a : PurCompactSupport.Change (s.coefficients l) (t.coefficients l))
    (_ha : Allowed l a)
    (A : Operation.{u, v} l Ω X Y (s.stage l))
    (B : Operation.{u, v} l Ω X Y (t.stage l))
    (rA : LeftRealization.{u, v} l Ω c s A)
    (rB : LeftRealization.{u, v} l Ω c t B)
    (SX : Scalar.{u, v} l Ω a X) (SY : Scalar.{u, v} l Ω a Y) :
    IsIso (Functor.whiskerLeft (RingStage.inclusion.{u, v} l Ω X s)
      (PurCompactSupport.comparison a c)) ∧
    ∀ (q : A.F ⋙ SY.functor ≅ SX.functor ⋙ B.F),
      (∀ K : C.{u, v} l Ω X (s.stage l),
        (RingStage.inclusion.{u, v} l Ω Y t).map (q.hom.app K) ≫
          rB.hom.app (SX.functor.obj K) ≫
          (PurCompactSupport.image (t.coefficients l) c).map (SX.realization.hom.app K) =
        SY.realization.hom.app (A.F.obj K) ≫
          (pbcDerivedExtend (a.map Y)).map (rA.hom.app K) ≫
          (PurCompactSupport.comparison a c).app
            ((RingStage.inclusion.{u, v} l Ω X s).obj K)) →
      IsIso (mateEquiv A.adjunction B.adjunction q.inv).natTrans
